About SURTIES

Built for people who want more of their city.

SURTIES connects people who want to meet others and experience more of Surat. Whether you are new to the city or simply looking for better plans, the community helps you find people to do things with.

  • Discover meetups, outings, and shared activities.
  • Interact respectfully. Participation is always voluntary.
  • Safety, boundaries, privacy, and mutual respect come first.
  • Community membership does not guarantee that every member or interaction is safe, so use your own judgment.

Meet the founder

Shanay

SURTIES was founded by Shanay with the aim of bringing people in Surat together through friendships, shared interests, and real-world experiences. The community is built around the idea that discovering your city can be better when you have people to share it with.

Shanay personally manages the community.

Community safety

Community rules & guidelines

Everyone who joins agrees to these basics. They exist so people can meet with confidence and respect.

  1. Respect all members.
  2. No harassment, threats, hate, or abusive behavior.
  3. Do not send unwanted personal messages, and stop contacting anyone who expresses discomfort.
  4. Do not pressure anyone to attend a meetup or share personal information.
  5. Do not post another person's phone number, private messages, or personal details without permission.
  6. Get permission before sharing identifiable photos or videos of other members.
  7. Meet in public, familiar places when possible.
  8. Tell someone you trust about your plans.
  9. Make your own travel and safety decisions.
  10. Report concerning behavior to the community administrator.
  11. Never share passwords, OTPs, identity documents, or unnecessary sensitive information in public groups.
  12. No scams, spam, misleading promotions, or unauthorized advertising.
  13. Follow venue rules and applicable law.
  14. Community verification does not guarantee anyone's identity, intentions, or behavior.

Emergency? If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services first. Do not rely on this website, a community group, or an administrator for urgent help.

Join SURTIES

Apply to join the community

Fill in the form below. Your application opens in WhatsApp, addressed to the SURTIES administrator. Send it, and it will be reviewed.

  1. Fill in your details and answer the rules question.
  2. Tap Submit. WhatsApp opens with your application already written.
  3. Send the message to the administrator.
  4. The administrator reviews applications and approves members.
5. Do you agree with the community rules and regulations above?
